note: What this file is: every painting used for chapter 1 of the austerity explainer (paper pop-up look), with the exact request sent to fal to paint it. Paintings are saved here as high-quality JPEG (quality 95, full colour detail) so the kit fits the 30 MB sending limit; the PNG originals stay in the austerity project. Masks are the background remover's black-and-white cut-out masks (fal-ai/birefnet/v2, model 'General Use (Dynamic)', 2304x2304, mask only). Backgrounds need no mask. Two paintings were rejected and are left out: 202 (shells that looked like rifle cartridges; 209 replaces it) and 208 (a tank with an odd shape; the page 3 tank, 5-tank, is used instead).
